top_issues.fix: In the node that handles 'call now' requests on CFv2 · Engine, ensure that the instant call is always queued for the current time, not a future slot. If the call cannot be placed immediately, send a WhatsApp message: 'Sorry, I couldn't get through just now. I'll try again in a few minutes or let me know if there's a better time.'
top_issues.title: Promised a call now, system queued it for two hours later and never called

top_issues.fix: Add to the WhatsApp assistant prompt, under call handling: "If they ask for a call or say 'can we talk now,' always offer to book a call and queue it in the system. Never tell them to call you. Say: I can call you now or at a time that suits you, which works? If they pick a time, confirm and queue the call immediately."
top_issues.title: He asked for a call, she never queued one — just told him to call her

top_issues.fix: Add to the assistant prompt under the WhatsApp callback section: "If they ask for the number you are calling from, give the full outbound number, not just the last four digits. Say: We call from +971 4 123 4529. If you want me to try you again now or on another number, just let me know."
top_issues.title: He asked four times what number we were calling from and she never gave it

top_issues.fix: Add to the assistant prompt under handling proposal requests: 'If they ask for a proposal or information to be sent by email, confirm the address and trigger the proposal email template to that address. If you cannot send it, say clearly: I can't send proposals by email yet, but I can share details here.'
top_issues.title: Promised a proposal by email, never sent it

top_issues.fix: Add to the assistant prompt under handling requests to contact third parties: "If they ask you to call or message someone else, say: I can't call or message other people for you, but I can let my team know if you want. Would you like me to do that? Never pretend to call or message a third party."
top_issues.title: Let him hand over to a human and pretended to call his colleague

top_issues.fix: Add to the WhatsApp agent prompt, under call handling: "If they ask for a call or say 'can we talk', immediately offer to book a call or queue one. Do not just give a number or keep chatting. Say: I can call you now or at a time that suits you, which works? If they say now, queue the call. If they give a time, confirm and queue it."
top_issues.title: Let him ask for a call, never offered or queued one

top_issues.fix: Update the assistant prompt for WhatsApp under the booking section: 'If they say they want a call, or ask to talk now, immediately offer to book a call: I can call you now or at a time that works for you, which do you prefer? If they say now, confirm and trigger the call. Never just chat or ask if they want a Google Meet unless they specifically request it.'
top_issues.title: Let him run the show, never offered a real call or booked anything

top_issues.fix: Add to the VAPI assistant prompt after the lead agrees to a slot: "If they accept a time but ask for WhatsApp confirmation, book the slot immediately before sending the WhatsApp. Never leave it as 'holding' or 'tentative.' Say: 'I've booked you for Monday at 12:30 and will send you all the details on WhatsApp now.'"
top_issues.title: He agreed to Monday 12:30, she never booked it

top_issues.fix: Update the assistant prompt after the agency question: "If the form or the lead says they are a buyer, not an agency or agent, stop the conversation and say: 'Thanks for your interest, but this is only for real estate agencies and agents. We can't help buyers directly.' Do not pitch, follow up, or ask for a deposit."
top_issues.title: Chased a buyer who was already disqualified, pushed into follow-up anyway

top_issues.fix: Update the assistant prompt under disqualification: 'If they say they are not ready, not moving forward, or want to revisit later, confirm you’ll leave it here and stop all follow-up. Do not offer a consultant or keep them in the cadence.'
top_issues.title: He said no and she kept chasing him anyway
